title: The Brainwashing Technique That Used a 'Soul Vacuum'—Members Breathed Into a Machine That 'Extracted' Sins
hook: A leader claimed a modified CPAP machine could suck out past sins; members wore it for hours until they hyperventilated into submission.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurd yet terrifying pseudoscience of a 'sin vacuum' is perfect for shocked reactions and commentary.

title: The Cult Leader Who Made Followers Wear Dead People's Clothes to 'Absorb Their Souls'
hook: New members had to wear garments from deceased former followers, believing the dead would 'guide' them into submission.
why_this_can_go_viral: The macabre visual of wearing a dead person's clothes is instantly creepy and shareable.
